title: Sultan
desc: Ashok is assigned to catch a terrorist named Sultan, who often disguises himself to hide his real identity. However, things take a turn when Ashok arrests Prithvi, Sultan's twin.

title: Veede
desc: Yedu, along with Manga and her grandmother, heads to Hyderabad to meet the minister to complain about a factory that is polluting the water of his village. He soon realises all is not as it seems.

title: Kurrodu
desc: Varun's bike becomes a lucky charm for him when it gets him a decent job and the adoration of his father. When the same bike is stolen, he gets mixed up in a world of drug smugglers.

title: Bahudoorapu Batasari
desc: Prasad, an honest police officer, brings up his sons with a lot of love and care. However, when he falls on hard times, his sons abandon him and he is forced to rebuild his life from scratch.

title: Michael Madana Kamaraju
desc: Madan meets Archana in Goa and confesses that he hates the idea of love but ends up falling for her. So, he asks his brother-in-law for help.

title: Swethanaagu
desc: Madhumati, a research scholar, visits a forest to look for the holy scripture Nagasastram. However, when she gets chased by a white snake, who seeks revenge from her, she strives to survive.

title: Drushyam
desc: A man lives a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. When his wife and eldest daughter get entangled in a grave crime, he must protect them from harm.

title: Angarakshakudu
desc: An honest policeman devises a plan to combat anti-social elements and vows to rid society of crime. He wages a determined war against lawlessness and corruption.

title: Ranadheera
desc: A tribal forest officer trains five women NCC cadets to plunge deep into the forest in order to save a satellite from conspiring foreigners.

title: Rajadhi Raja
desc: Raja, a rich estate owner's son, comes back from abroad in order to avenge his dead father. However, things get complicated when he is framed, and he finds his doppelganger in his village.
